_doc: Established relationships used as a test set (written before the model fits). kind: 'exclusive' = the two events rarely co-occur; 'cooccur' = they co-occur more than chance; 'before' = a typically precedes b. Each is checked against the co-occurrence baseline, the MHN (theta and simulated order) and, for 'before', the within-patient clone orders. References are to well-established cytogenetic biology (WHO/ELN classifications and standard reviews).

AML.why: 5q loss belongs to secondary/complex AML, rare in CBF AML
+22 is a characteristic secondary change of inv(16)
sex-chromosome loss is a characteristic secondary change of t(8;21)

MDS.why: del(5q) is an early event; TP53/17p loss marks progression

CML.why: BCR-ABL1 is the founding event; additional changes mark progression
major-route abnormalities cluster in blast phase

ALL.why: trisomies 4 and 10 define favourable high hyperdiploid ALL
monosomy 7 is a common secondary change in Ph-positive ALL
9p (CDKN2A) loss is a common secondary change in Ph-positive ALL

CLL.why: trisomy 12 and del(13q) are largely alternative early events
del(13q) is early; del(17p) is acquired with progression
trisomy 12 is early; del(17p) is acquired with progression

APL.why: PML-RARA is the founding event; +8 the commonest secondary change

MM.why: IGH-translocated and hyperdiploid myeloma are largely distinct
IGH-translocated and hyperdiploid myeloma are largely distinct
